title: rangetest tests: dead seq assert and missing 4.01 payload-length assert
description: lichen/tests/coap_rangetest/src/main.c:266: zassert_equal(lichen_rangetest_seq(), 0U, "4.01 must not mutate") cannot fail even with the gate deleted — the POST handler never mutates s_seq (only lichen_rangetest_update does). Drop it or comment it honestly. Also the GET authz test's 4.01 branches do not assert response_payload_len == 0 while the POST test does — a payload-leaking 4.01 in the GET path would go unnoticed; add the assert for symmetry.
close_reason: Fixed in 750fed2ed7; twister qemu_x86/atom 13/13 test cases passed
